intro: Follow the stages in order. Story first, while grabbing every missable trophy in its mission window; then strangers, collectibles, activities, and a money clean-up. The platinum pops when the last trophy does.

stages.summary: Chapters 1 to 4 plus the final mission. Five trophies can only be earned in their story moment, so do them the first time the scene plays.
tips: Take the cocktail on Ocean Beach when the scene offers it (In The Beginning…)
Smash out of the vehicle showroom in the story scene (Capital Offense)
Bowl properly at the Kolt & Associates alley visit (Let’s Go Bowling)
Play the partnership's big public scene through without skipping (Personal Best)
Make the unscheduled departure at VCIA during VCIA Takedown (Catch Me If You Can)
stages.title: Play the story — and catch the missables

stages.summary: Clear every stranger strand before the finale: the five named contacts plus three more strands, for 8 in total.
tips: Follow the question-mark markers as they appear on the map
Finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone before the final mission
Hunt Bret's unique animal when his mission appears
stages.title: Strangers and side missions

stages.summary: Sweep the map region by region: photo spots, cards, meditation spots, vehicles and all 52 areas.
tips: WAiNK It at 100 locations
Complete 3 collectible card sets
Meditate at all 18 spots
Discover 100 vehicles
Visit all 52 areas of Leonida
stages.title: Collectibles across Leonida

stages.summary: The skill grinds: shooting range golds, stunts, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, and 50 challenges.
tips: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges
Win 20 different races and a drone race at all 14 locations
Rob 5 bank vaults and one illegal operation per gang
Bank 500 choices and 50 challenges along the way
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.summary: Launder the marked bills, spend big, buy the garages and register your rides.
tips: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through contacts
Spend $100,000 across all shops
Buy all 8 garage properties
Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app
stages.title: Money clean-up

stages.summary: Check the stats screen: 100% completion is the last gate, and the platinum follows it.
tips: Confirm every category in the pause-menu stats screen
Attain 100% Completion, then the platinum unlocks
stages.title: Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
